sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Broad sector participation remains severely constricted with only Healthcare achieving all-green status, while Energy and Technology continue to command the top momentum leadership ranks.

Leadership remains concentrated in Energy (momentum score 0.833, rank 1) and Technology (momentum score 0.783, rank 2), with Technology maintaining sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Healthcare also displays robust multi-timeframe health as the lone sector positive across all measured windows (week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD) with a 0.700 momentum score.

Rotation has stalled across the board over the past five sessions, leaving lower-tier cyclicals and rate-sensitive groups fading. Consumer Cyclical sits at the bottom of the board (momentum score 0.383, rank 11), while Real Estate (0.250 momentum, rank 8) and Utilities (0.217 momentum, rank 10) anchor the laggard list.

## Strength
- **Healthcare breadth:** Healthcare is the sole all-green sector (1 of 11 groups) positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods, backed by a 0.700 momentum score.
- **Persistent Technology leadership:** Technology continues to demonstrate sustained strength, holding top-3 rankings across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes with a 0.783 momentum score.
- **Energy at the helm:** Energy retains the market's highest momentum reading at 0.833, firmly holding the rank 1 position.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Momentum top tier:** Energy (0.833), Technology (0.783), and Healthcare (0.700) lead the momentum rankings, followed by Consumer Defensive (0.617).
- **Frozen 5-day rankings:** Ranks across all tracked sectors showed net zero shifts (+0 spots) over the last five sessions, indicating a static performance hierarchy.
- **Deepest laggards:** Utilities (0.217) and Real Estate (0.250) hold the weakest momentum scores, with Consumer Cyclical lagging the broader market at rank 11 (0.383).

## Divergences
- **Narrow leadership vs. breadth:** Despite Energy's dominant 0.833 momentum, it lacks all-green status across all timeframes, contrasting with Healthcare's full-period breadth.
- **Cyclical vs. defensive split:** Defensive groups (Healthcare at 0.700, Consumer Defensive at 0.617) outrank key cyclicals, with Financial (0.350) and Consumer Cyclical (0.383) languishing near the bottom.
- **Lack of active rank anomalies:** Fragile all-green early-warning signals showed no active sector breaches across the current dataset.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy, infrastructure tech, and defensive staples are solidifying market leadership while real estate, housing, and telecom face acute short-term deterioration.

Leadership remains concentrated in select commodity and infrastructure pockets, with Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.991 momentum) and Communication Equipment (0.924 momentum) maintaining elite profiles. Overall breadth shows 20 of 144 groups holding all-green trends across all timeframes. Rotation is favoring defensive and consumer segments, evidenced by sharp 5-day rank surges in Tobacco (+17 to rank 32) and Beverages - Brewers (+13 to rank 34).

Conversely, housing and rate-sensitive pockets are fading rapidly. Real Estate - Development (-15 spots to rank 96), REIT - Office (-14 spots to rank 89), and Residential Construction (-13 spots to rank 116) suffered heavy 5-day declines, accompanied by Telecom Services tumbling 22 spots to rank 118 with a depressed 0.13 momentum score.

## Strength
- **Core Leaders:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.991, rank_ytd 1) and Communication Equipment (momentum 0.924, rank_ytd 5) head the 20 all-green groups that are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods.
- **Sustained Profiles:** Copper (0.854 momentum), Health Information Services (0.840 momentum), Software - Infrastructure (0.839 momentum), and Diagnostics & Research (0.81 momentum) hold top-36 rank consistency across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Energy Breadth:** Oil & Gas Integrated reinforced energy sector strength with an all-green profile and an 0.82 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Advancers:** Tobacco gained 17 spots to reach rank 32 (momentum 0.83), while Beverages - Brewers (+13 to rank 34), Discount Stores (+13 to rank 66), Internet Retail (+13 to rank 65), and Utilities - Regulated Water (+13 to rank 47) all posted double-digit rank jumps.
- **Top 5-Day Decliners:** Telecom Services led decliners, falling 22 spots to rank 118, followed by Shell Companies dropping 21 spots to rank 50 and Real Estate - Development falling 15 spots to rank 96.
- **Momentum Troughs:** Mortgage Finance (0.031 momentum, rank_ytd 142) and REIT - Mortgage (0.061 momentum, rank_ytd 135) remain the weakest groups in the market, followed closely by Recreational Vehicles (0.066 momentum).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Internet Content & Information (momentum 0.73, -3 spots in 5d), Department Stores (momentum 0.69, -8 spots in 5d), and Shell Companies (momentum 0.60, -21 spots in 5d) are exhibiting distribution despite solid absolute momentum scores.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Consulting Services gained 9 spots over 5 sessions despite an 0.38 momentum score, alongside Utilities - Diversified (+8 spots, 0.44 momentum) and Personal Services (+4 spots, 0.27 momentum), signaling early turnarounds from lower bases.
